tool_input.command: sed -i '' 's/if (weightKg < maxWeightKg)/if (weightKg <= maxWeightKg)/' src/Storefront/Shipping/ShippingCalculator.cs && git diff && cat tests/Storefront.Specs/ShippingCalculatorTests.cs .gitlab-ci.yml && dotnet test 2>&1 | tail -30
tool_input.description: Fix bracket boundary comparison and run the test suite

result:
- **Cause:** The "Add express shipping" commit (a67da70) refactored the weight brackets into a table but changed the comparison from `<=` to `<`. A parcel of exactly 5 kg fell into the 20 kg bracket (14.90 instead of 7.90). The same slip affected exactly 1 kg and 20 kg; it is a real regression, not a runner-02 problem.
- **Action:** In `src/Storefront/Shipping/ShippingCalculator.cs`, `RateFor` now uses `weightKg <= maxWeightKg` again. This is a one-character code fix with no test changes, and all 42 tests pass locally.

The fix is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline stays red until you push it:

```
git commit -am "Fix inclusive upper bound on shipping weight brackets" && git push
```
